item.title: Sentiment Analysis Using BERT
item.description:
Institution

National University of Sciences and Technology, Islamabad, Pakistan
Oct 2023 - Dec 2023

Project Description

For this project I built a sentiment classifier using BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers). BERT reads each word in the context of the whole sentence, which matters a lot for sentiment, where a single word like “not” can flip the meaning.

Project Highlights

  • Fine-tuned pre-trained BERT models for sentiment classification instead of training from scratch.
  • Prepared the text data with standard NLP preprocessing before training.
  • Wrote the pipeline in Python using HuggingFace Transformers and TensorFlow.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Python
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  • BERT
  • Machine Learning
  • Data Preprocessing
